English: Stone Platform
A simple, hastily raised stone platform for ritual sky burials, marking the first step in establishing a Tower of Silence.
Small Tower of Silence
A modest, free-standing stone tower, providing a proper environment for sky burials and attracting the attention of local priests.
Circular Platform
A rudimentary circular stone structure raised to separate the sacred from the profane, facilitating proper funerary rites.
Enclosed Tower of Silence
A fortified, enclosed funerary tower with dedicated chambers for priests and watchers, further sanctifying the burial ground.
Walled Tower
Encircled by a defensive wall, this tower protects sacred rites from prying eyes and desecration, marking a step towards architectural permanence.
Ornate Tower of Silence
A grand funerary tower with elaborate ornamentation, rare stones, and dedicated prayer halls, attracting pilgrims from afar.
Decorated Tower
A tower adorned with intricate carvings and religious motifs, reflecting growing wealth and devotion.
Grand Tower of Silence
A monumental, multi-tiered tower, home to a center of religious learning and administration, renowned throughout the region.
Sanctified Tower
A tower consecrated by the highest priests, serving as a beacon of the faith, with sacred fires and relics enshrined within.
Blessed Tower of Silence
The holiest funerary tower, known across the world, drawing pilgrims, scholars, and the faithful, radiating spiritual authority and prosperity.
